finding: The frozen NPS cost gate is INVALID on the shared 2-core sandbox.
method: A/A null: both arms the identical champion binary and options, no PST in either arm, so the true ratio is exactly 1.0. Every FAIL is a false reject.
conclusions: No statistic rescues the gate on this host: the best (median of paired ratios) still false-rejects 4/12.
Between-rep host drift (median arm CV 5.3%) exceeds the 3% band half-width, so more reps alone is not a fix on a drifting host.

A PASS is as uninformative as a FAIL on the SANDBOX: exp-0048's recorded 1.00967 'PASS' does NOT establish that the PST is free per node. This is now resolved for FUTURE work: an isolated runner false-rejected 0/6 at the same 3 reps, so the gate is usable THERE. The historical sandbox numbers remain uninformative and were not re-run.
exp-0049's recorded 0.93931 'FAIL' does NOT establish a 6% per-node cost.
Neither experiment's VERDICT changes: both closed on the ACCURACY gate, which is timing-independent.
required_fix_for_any_future_prereg: Measure the cost gate on an ISOLATED GitHub-hosted runner (as Tier-1 strength matches already do), never on the shared sandbox.
Run an A/A null on that host FIRST and require its false-reject rate to be 0 over >=5 gate evaluations before any candidate arm is measured.
Freeze the statistic, rep count and band in the prereg only after that A/A validation passes.
Keep node counts bit-identical as a structural check; it is the one part of the protocol that was never in doubt.
scope_limits: Does NOT reopen, re-run or re-score exp-0048 or exp-0049; both remain CLOSED NEGATIVE.
Does NOT license any claim that a candidate is free per node.
Instrument validation only; zero strength games.

isolated_runner_validation.status: COMPLETED - the required fix is verified
isolated_runner_validation.verdict: ISOLATED RUNNER CAN RESOLVE THE BAND
interpretation: At the SAME frozen 3 reps, the isolated runner false-rejected 0/6 while the sandbox false-rejected 80%.
A/A scatter on the runner (half-range 0.0057) is ~5x tighter than the 0.03 band half-width, so the +/-3% band is resolvable there.
Residual arm self-spread of 5.87% still exists on the runner, but the median-of-3 statistic absorbs it; the band decision was correct in all 6 evaluations.
This validates the HOST and the PROTOCOL, not any candidate. No candidate was measured.
required_for_any_future_cost_gate: Run on an isolated GitHub-hosted runner via .github/workflows/dev6-cost-gate.yml, never on the shared sandbox.
Re-run the A/A null on the runner in the SAME session as the candidate measurement and require zero false rejects over >=5 evaluations before trusting the candidate ratio.
Freeze statistic, reps and band in the candidate's own prereg before its corpus exists.
One A/A pass does not permanently certify the host: runner hardware/images vary, so validate per session.
export_lane_defects_found_and_fixed: run.log was silently dropped: .gitignore has *.log and 'git add -A' skipped it while SHA256SUMS.txt still listed it. Fixed by force-adding logs, as the tier1 lane already did.
The new completeness guard first tested 'git diff --cached', which omits already-committed unchanged files on a RE-export and failed spuriously. Corrected to test the INDEX via git ls-files.
Added post-push verification of the COMMITTED blobs, which is what a consumer actually retrieves; the working-tree check alone had passed on an incomplete mirror.
